details:
I noticed something is weird on some avatars, and try find out why bones are just gone and not converted correctly.
Then i found the culprit. Dynamic Bones has "Exclusions" list below to ignore some bones for interaction.
Funny enough, new Phys Bone has now another named "Ignore Transforms" list. This seems pretty simliar to "Exclusions" because it will ignore other bones.
But the conversion tool in SDK seems not be able to convert it and can "crash" on some bone settings, makes them just empty. Only DB bones with empty "Exclusions" list, so it's zero, will converted succesfully and generated.
I will see it as a bug, because it's of course not supposed some bone components are erased by conversion tool, only because it has Exclusions list.

Second "bug" is the multiple DB components in gameobject. The conversion tool seems cannot see many at same time and choose just last component, ignoring other bone component settings. Is multiple Phys Bone components not allowed at one gameobject bone? I hope this is not another bug or limited feature of conversion tool. This is important question for VRChat developers.

Solution atm:
- Make duplicate of your avatar (CTRL+D)
- on new duplicated avatar, check all DB bones for "Exclusions" list. Make it zero.
- If all bones are checked carefully, you can now use conversion tool.
- After conversion tool, apply missing bones in new generated PB component in "Ignore Transforms" so it should act pretty same as DB before, using the original avatar settings. Then you're back to where it's supposed.
- When it's done, you can delete original avatar. But you can keep it as prefab, then erase it. Prefabs can used later if you have new problems to inspect again DB settings.
That is my report here. Don't run suddenly conversion tool or press Auto-Fix, always check your avatar first and make duplicate.
title: [2022.04.21] DB auto conversion bug with "Exclusions" lists. (and 1 more bug)
